decisions.rule: Keep each provider's OI, funding, liquidation and coverage as separate timestamped panels. Never average incomparable provider totals.
Align market and ETF observations to UTC event cutoffs; an ETF session closing before an incident cannot be labelled an incident response.
Do not infer token-specific market demand from aggregate exchange reserve/replenishment amounts without token quantities and execution evidence.
Use BOJ, yen, dollar and Treasury observations as context features only after point-in-time history, source provenance and walk-forward validation.
No directional forecast until fixed-horizon labels, baselines, leakage controls, calibration and out-of-sample evaluation are in place.
